## About
PS Auto Body is a full service auto body shop on W Baker Ave in Englewood. We handle collision repair, frame repair, full service paint and custom refinishing, and there is no job too big for us.
Estimates are by appointment only, so call ahead and we'll find a time that works. One reviewer calls us family-owned, and a few have mentioned Vadim by name for walking them through the process.
We're rated 5 from 87 Google reviews, and we'd like to keep earning that one car at a time.

## Services
- Full service auto body shop: Auto body repairs of all kinds, big or small.
- Collision repair estimates: Estimates are available by appointment only. Call us to schedule a time.
- Full service paint: Painting work done in our shop.
- Paintless dent and hail repair: Dent and hail damage repair without repainting.
- Full service frame repair: Frame repair after an accident.
- Custom autobody refinishing: Custom refinishing work for your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: Yes. Estimates are available by appointment only, so please call us to schedule a time.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and closed on weekends.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: One reviewer said Vadim worked with her insurance company on her repair and kept communication open the whole time.

Q: Is my job too big for you?
A: We take on everything from bumpers to frame repair. There is no job too big for us.

Vadim was patient with my questions, kept communication open, and worked with the insurance company.
It took a day or two to get my car in for repair. The insurance approved a rental car. The rental location wasn’t close to the shop. Vadim helped arrange transferring the reservation to a closer rental car location. He called them. They picked me up and I didn’t have to hoof it across town to the other location. It made the process less stressful. The rental car company also spoke highly of the shop.
Less than a month later, they called to tell me my car was ready.  It looks like new again! My husband came with me for pickup. He was impressed with the work & took some business cards. Family-owned.
Excellent quality, fabulous communication, knowledgeable and easy to work with! If you find yourself in need…would absolutely recommend this shop!" (Robin R, 5/5)
